# Contributing

Contributions are welcome when they keep findings explainable, auditable, privacy-aware, and honest
about model capability.

1. Follow the [development guide](../docs/development.md).
2. Add focused offline tests for behavior changes.
3. Run the complete quality and provenance gate.
4. Update documentation and the [changelog](../docs/changelog.md).
5. Open a focused pull request with evidence, limitations, and migration notes.

Do not attach identifiable worksite footage, credentials, private checkpoints, or proprietary
datasets. New media/evaluation artifacts must use an approved open-source/public-domain license and
be registered in [`docs/legal/provenance.yaml`](../docs/legal/provenance.yaml).

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub Security Advisories, not public issues.
